id: 1998-埃塞俄比亞-厄立特里亞戰爭
theater: 提格雷北部與德梅戰線

battle.name: 埃塞俄比亞-厄立特里亞戰爭
battle.theater: 提格雷北部與德梅戰線
battle.brief: 一九九八年五月六日，厄立特里亞裝甲部隊越入德梅爭議區，與提格雷民兵及埃塞俄比亞警察交火，兩國隨即全面動員。卡面這件T-55主力戰車正是雙方裝甲骨幹，支撐了德梅與佐羅納一線的壕溝攻擊與裝甲對決。這場被觀察者稱為第二次世界大戰以來非洲最激烈的戰事，前後打了兩年，最後以《阿爾及爾協議》停火收場。

kit.name: T-55主力戰車
kit.history: T-55是蘇聯第二代中型戰車，設計用于提供可靠的火力與裝甲支援，于冷戰期間大量裝備蘇聯及受援國家，成爲地面部隊的主力裝甲平台。

countries: 交戰雙方是兩個由前解放運動掌權的國家，指揮體系都帶有鮮明的「人民戰爭」色彩。埃塞俄比亞一方是人民革命民主陣線（EPRDF）領導的埃塞俄比亞國防軍，核心是人民解放軍（PLA）與提格雷人民解放陣線（TPLF）出身的將領集團；總理梅萊斯·澤納維以總統兼武裝力量最高指揮官身份主持軍政，參謀長先後由察德坎·格雷布滕薩、耶爾馬·格雷布·塞拉西擔任，陸軍主力是若干機械化師與步兵師，空軍由米格、蘇式戰機與米-24武裝直升機組成，並得到中國與俄羅斯等國的軍火供應。厄立特里亞一方是人民解放陣線（EPLF）執政的國家，總統伊賽亞斯·阿福韋里直接統率人民解放軍，參謀長一級先後由塞巴哈特·埃普雷姆、奧格貝·阿布拉哈等將領出任，軍隊以獨立戰爭年代繳獲的蘇式裝備為骨幹，並靠「薩瓦」徵兵制在短時間內拉起大量新兵。開戰前厄立特里亞常備兵約四萬人，坦克二至三百輛但部分無法作戰；埃塞俄比亞軍力約十二萬人，坦克三百五十至四百輛，到全面動員時雙方各湊出近二十五萬人。外部方面，非洲統一組織與美國、盧旺達先後推出和平方案，聯合國安理會亦以多號決議介入。
countriesEn: The two sides were states ruled by former liberation movements, and both command systems carried the strong flavour of a people's war. The Ethiopian side was the Ethiopian National Defense Force under the Ethiopian People's Revolutionary Democratic Front (EPRDF), whose core was the People's Liberation Army (PLA) and the cadre of officers who had risen with the Tigray People's Liberation Front (TPLF). Prime Minister Meles Zenawi presided over the armed forces as president and supreme commander, the post of chief of staff being held first by Tsadkan Gebretensae and then by Yilma Gebre Selassie; the army's main body was a number of mechanised and infantry divisions, the air force was built from MiG and Sukhoi aircraft together with Mi-24 armed helicopters, and the country was resupplied with weapons from China, Russia and other states. The Eritrean side was the state governed by the Eritrean People's Liberation Front (EPLF), where President Isaias Afwerki commanded the People's Liberation Army directly, with officers such as Sebhat Ephrem and Ogbe Abraha serving as chiefs of staff in different phases; the army was built around Soviet equipment captured during the war of independence, and mass numbers of fresh recruits were raised in a short time through the 'Sawa' conscription system. Before the war Eritrea had an estimated 40,000 troops and 200 to 300 tanks, not all of them operational, while Ethiopia fielded about 120,000 troops and 350 to 400 tanks; at full mobilisation each side had assembled close to 250,000 men. On the outside, the Organisation of African Unity and a United States–Rwanda peace plan sought to intervene, and the United Nations Security Council also became involved through a series of resolutions.
people: 這場戰爭的關鍵人物集中在兩國最高層。埃塞俄比亞總理梅萊斯·澤納維出身提格雷，父親是提格雷牧師，他本人曾被厄立特里亞人民解放陣線關押，在德梅屬於提格雷領土這一點上無法退讓；參謀長察德坎·格雷布滕薩長期主持軍機，一九九八年由耶爾馬·格雷布·塞拉西接任；薩莫拉·尤尼斯是前線指揮官，他看過厄立特里亞軍修築的野戰陣地後留下那句名言：「厄立特里亞人擅長挖壕溝，我們擅長把壕溝變成墳墓。他們也曉得，我們彼此都很了解。」厄立特里亞方面，總統伊賽亞斯·阿福韋里是唯一決策者，他既是戰爭的發動者也是停戰的接受者；參謀長塞巴哈特·埃普雷姆與奧格貝·阿布拉哈分別在不同階段主持軍務。戰局之外，阿爾及利亞總統布特弗利卡主持談判並以《阿爾及爾協議》收束戰事，聯合國秘書長科菲·安南多次發出警告，美國與盧旺達提出的四點和平方案則在初期被厄立特里亞拒絕。
peopleEn: The decisive personalities of this war sat at the top of both states. Ethiopian Prime Minister Meles Zenawi came from Tigray, the son of a Tigrayan pastor, and had himself been held prisoner by the EPLF; because Badme lay in Tigrayan territory he could not give way. Chief of staff Tsadkan Gebretensae ran the military machine for a long time and was succeeded in 1998 by Yilma Gebre Selassie. Samora Yunis commanded on the front line, and after surveying the field works the Eritreans had dug he left the famous remark: 'The Eritreans are good at digging trenches and we are good at converting trenches into graves. They, too, know this. We know each other very well.' On the Eritrean side President Isaias Afwerki was the sole decision maker, both the man who launched the war and the man who had to accept the ceasefire; Sebhat Ephrem and Ogbe Abraha took charge of military affairs at different stages of the fighting. Beyond the battlefield, Algerian President Abdelaziz Bouteflika hosted the talks that closed the conflict with the Algiers Agreement, UN Secretary-General Kofi Annan issued repeated warnings, and the four-point peace plan proposed by the United States and Rwanda was rejected by Eritrea in the opening phase.
kits: 卡面這件T-55主力戰車是一九五八年蘇聯烏拉爾車輛製造廠量產的第二代中型戰車，裝100毫米D-10T線膛炮、45發100毫米炮塔彈藥，車體與首上裝甲為傾斜鋼板，發動機為V-12系列柴油機，最大公路速度約每小時五十公里，最大行程約四百至五百公里，乘員四人。它是這場戰爭裡唯一真正決定戰線的地面裝備：埃塞俄比亞三百五十至四百輛、厄立特里亞二百至三百輛的坦克編制中，T-55佔了絕對多數，雙方都在德梅、佐羅納與馬雷布河一線大量挖掘掩體，把T-55當成可移動的射擊堡壘使用。與之對抗的還有少量T-62，其115毫米炮在遠距離對射上略佔上風；埃塞俄比亞空軍以米格-21bis、米格-23BN、蘇-25TK配合米-24武裝直升機提供近距火力支援，厄立特里亞則有四架米格-29A與少量米格-21bis、米-24；炮兵方面雙方大量使用130毫米牽引炮、152毫米榴彈炮與BM-21「冰雹」多管火箭炮。運輸與後勤工具落後得多，埃塞俄比亞靠驢、馬等馱畜為步兵輸送彈藥，甚至出現過用貨車平板代替專用戰車運輸架的情況。
kitsEn: The T-55 main battle tank shown on the card is the second generation Soviet medium tank mass-produced by the Uralvagonzavod works from 1958, armed with the 100 mm D-10T rifled gun, carrying 45 rounds in the turret, built with sloped steel armour for hull and turret, powered by a V-12 series diesel, and capable of roughly 50 km/h on roads and 400 to 500 km of range with a crew of four. It was the only piece of ground equipment that actually decided the battle lines: of the 350 to 400 tanks fielded by Ethiopia and the 200 to 300 fielded by Eritrea, the T-55 made up the overwhelming majority on both sides, and both sides dug in heavily along Badme, Tsorona and the Mareb river, using the tank as a mobile firing bastion. Facing it were a smaller number of T-62s, whose 115 mm gun held a slight edge in long-range duels. The Ethiopian air force used MiG-21bis, MiG-23BN and Su-25TK aircraft together with Mi-24 armed helicopters for close air support, while Eritrea had four MiG-29As along with a few MiG-21bis and Mi-24s. On the artillery side both armies used large numbers of 130 mm towed guns, 152 mm howitzers and BM-21 Grad multiple rocket launchers. Transport and logistics were far more backward: Ethiopia relied on donkeys and other pack animals to carry ammunition to the infantry, and there were even cases of flat-bed trucks being used in place of purpose-built tank transporters.
tactics: 整場戰爭的戰術樣貌是「戰壕對戰壕」的消耗。厄立特里亞人民解放軍以工兵見長，沿德梅、佐羅納等邊境要點修築縱深戰壕、蛇腹堡壘與反戰車壕，把平原上的機動作戰拖成接近第一次世界大戰的消耗；埃塞俄比亞則以步兵密集波次正面衝鋒，在炮火準備之後靠密集步兵消耗對方機槍與迫擊炮火力，坦克如薩莫拉·尤尼斯所述「留作預備，等步兵奪下陣地再向前推進」，這令裝甲部隊多數時間只扮演鞏固與掃蕩的角色，而正面突破的傷亡極高。埃塞俄比亞真正奏效的是側翼迂迴：一九九九年二月「夕照行動」先以四架戰機空襲阿薩卜機場，再以炮兵牽制佐羅納方向，三個師在畢尤昆迪突破後向杜坎比亞推進，再折向東面擊潰德梅以北的厄立特里亞師，迫使其丟下近一百公里工事與大部分重武器；五月十二日又以四個裝甲師、二十二個步兵師在多路同時發動合成攻勢，在尚布科與門德費拉之間撕開缺口，渡過馬雷布河，切斷巴倫圖至門德費拉這條西線主補給公路。厄軍另一手是讓坦克分散隱蔽、以反坦克武器與地雷封鎖隘口，並在無法固守時主動戰術退卻、保存實力。
tacticsEn: The tactical character of the whole war was a war of attrition between trench lines. The Eritrean People's Liberation Army, strong in its engineer troops, built deep trench systems, serpentine bunkers and anti-tank ditches around the border points of Badme and Tsorona, dragging mobile warfare on the plains back toward the attritional pattern of the First World War. Ethiopia, for its part, sent infantry forward in dense successive waves, consuming the machine-gun and mortar fire of the defenders after an artillery preparation, and, as Samora Yunis put it, 'held the tanks in reserve and brought them forward only once the infantry had taken the position', which meant the armoured units spent most of the campaign in the role of consolidation and mopping up, while frontal breakthroughs cost dearly. What really worked for Ethiopia was the flanking move. In the offensive codenamed Operation Sunset in February 1999, four fighter jets first struck Assab airfield, artillery pinned down the Tsorona front, and three divisions broke through at Biyukundi, pushed towards Dukambiya, then swung east and crushed the Eritrean division north of Badme, forcing it to abandon nearly 100 km of field works and most of its heavy weapons. On 12 May a much larger combined-arms offensive went in with four armoured and twenty-two infantry divisions on multiple axes, tearing a gap between Shambuko and Mendefera, fording the Mareb river and cutting the Barentu–Mendefera road, the main supply artery on the western front. The Eritreans, for their part, dispersed and concealed their tanks, sealed passes with anti-tank weapons and mines, and when a position could no longer be held, withdrew tactically in order to preserve the bulk of their strength.
data: 可查證的數字集中在兵員、坦克與傷亡三方面。戰前厄立特里亞常備兵約四萬人，埃塞俄比亞約十二萬人，坦克分別為二百至三百輛（部分不可用）與三百五十至四百輛；全面動員後雙方兵員各近二十五萬人，交火自一九九八年五月六日打到二〇〇〇年六月十八日停火、十二月十二日簽署《阿爾及爾協議》。傷亡數字各方說法懸殊：厄立特里亞官方稱本方陣亡約一萬九千人，埃塞俄比亞稱己方損失三萬四千至六萬人，並稱造成厄方陣亡至多六萬七千人；被俘人數埃方稱二千六百人、厄方稱一千一百人；國際危機研究組的估計是雙方合計七萬至十萬人陣亡，也有分析者認為總死亡人數可高達三十萬；僅「夕照行動」一次攻勢，獨立觀察者便估計雙方約三萬人陣亡。裝備損失方面，厄立特里亞宣稱在佐羅納方向擊毀四十五輛埃塞俄比亞戰車，厄方損失四架米格-29A，埃方損失三架米格-21bis、一架米格-23BN、一架蘇-25TK與兩架以上米-24。戰後埃塞俄比亞的復原工程牽涉逾十四萬八千名退役人員，為期六年，總花費一億七千四百萬美元，其中絕大部分靠世界銀行一億七千萬美元貸款支付。
dataEn: The verifiable figures cluster around manpower, tanks and casualties. Before the war Eritrea had about 40,000 regular troops and Ethiopia about 120,000, with 200 to 300 tanks (not all operational) against 350 to 400; after full mobilisation each side had close to 250,000 men, and the shooting ran from 6 May 1998 to the ceasefire of 18 June 2000, with the Algiers Agreement signed on 12 December. Casualty figures are wildly divergent: the Eritrean government officially put its own dead at about 19,000, while Ethiopia claimed to have lost between 34,000 and 60,000 of its own men and to have inflicted up to 67,000 Eritrean deaths; the number of prisoners taken is given as 2,600 by the Ethiopian side and 1,100 by the Eritrean side; the International Crisis Group estimated 70,000 to 100,000 killed on both sides combined, while some analysts put the overall death toll as high as 300,000; for the single Operation Sunset offensive alone, independent observers estimated around 30,000 dead on both sides. In equipment losses, Eritrea claimed to have destroyed 45 Ethiopian tanks in the Tsorona sector; Eritrea lost four MiG-29As, and Ethiopia lost three MiG-21bis, one MiG-23BN, one Su-25TK and more than two Mi-24s. After the war, Ethiopia's demobilisation, disarmament and reintegration programme covered more than 148,000 former fighters over six years and cost 174 million US dollars, most of it covered by a 170 million dollar World Bank loan.
cause: 戰爭的起因是多層糾結的邊界爭議加上相互指認的代理人戰爭。一九六二年，厄立特里亞在聯邦時期從提格雷吞併了哈曾一帶土地，之後德梅地區的主權歸屬長期未有定論，兩國的地圖、測量與村界記錄各執一詞。一九九一年內戰結束、埃塞俄比亞新政府上台後，兩國關係迅速惡化：埃塞俄比亞指控厄立特里亞支持其境內的反政府武裝與反對派，厄立特里亞則指控埃塞俄比亞支持奧羅米亞解放陣線等武裝，並縱容反對派跨境襲擊。一九九七至九八年間，邊界武裝衝突不斷，厄方軍官在德梅附近被殺，局勢因而失控，最終一九九八年五月六日厄立特里亞裝甲部隊越過邊界進入爭議區，與提格雷民兵及埃塞俄比亞警察交火，戰爭全面爆發。期間美國與盧旺達提出要求雙方退回一九九八年六月前陣地的四點和平方案，遭厄立特里亞拒絕，厄方反而要求全面非軍事化並直接談判，談判屢屢破裂。
causeEn: The causes of the war were a tangle of border dispute and mutually alleged proxy warfare. In 1962 Eritrea, then still a province of Ethiopia, annexed the Hawzen area from Tigray, and after that the sovereignty of the Badme district was never settled; the two countries held conflicting maps, surveys and village boundary records. After the civil war ended in 1991 and a new Ethiopian government took power, relations soured quickly: Ethiopia accused Eritrea of backing insurgents and anti-government groups on its own soil, while Eritrea accused Ethiopia of supporting the Oromo Liberation Front and other armed groups and of tolerating cross-border raids by the opposition. Armed clashes along the border multiplied through 1997 and 1998, Eritrean officers were killed near Badme, and the situation ran out of control until on 6 May 1998 an Eritrean mechanised force crossed the line into the disputed zone and clashed with Tigrayan militia and Ethiopian police, and the war opened in full. During this period the United States and Rwanda offered a four-point plan calling on both sides to withdraw to their positions of June 1998, which Eritrea refused, instead demanding complete demilitarisation of the disputed areas under neutral monitoring and direct talks; the negotiations broke down repeatedly.
impact: 戰爭的後果遠超出雙方邊境本身。安理會先後通過第1177號決議譴責動用武力，一九九九年五月十七日以第1298號決議對兩國實施武器禁運，二〇〇〇年七月三十一日再以第1312號決議設立二十五公里寬的臨時安全區，並由來自六十多國的聯合國埃塞俄比亞與厄立特里亞特派團進駐巡邏。戰後兩國在海牙組成邊界委員會，二〇〇二年四月十四日常設仲裁法院作出最終且有約束力的裁決，把爭議區大部分判給厄立特里亞；二〇〇五年邊界委員會亦確認德梅歸厄方，但埃塞俄比亞未全面執行，爭端延續。軍事上，厄立特里亞的重裝部隊被形容為遭到重創，長期依賴「薩瓦」徵兵制維持兵力的體制難以為繼，厄軍在邊境與內地同時受困；埃塞俄比亞雖保住國土，卻背上龐大的復原與安置包袱，軍隊素質、裝備更新與後勤都待重整。戰爭亦把代理人衝突推向區域，厄立特里亞支援索馬里的奧加登解放陣線，埃塞俄比亞則支持反對派並與蘇丹關係升溫，東非與紅海沿岸的國際航運與貿易風險同步上升。
impactEn: The consequences of the war reached far beyond the border itself. The Security Council first adopted Resolution 1177 condemning the use of force, then on 17 May 1999 imposed an arms embargo on both countries through Resolution 1298, and on 31 July 2000 adopted Resolution 1312 creating a 25-kilometre-wide Temporary Security Zone, patrolled by the United Nations Mission in Ethiopia and Eritrea with personnel from more than sixty countries. After the war the two states set up a boundary commission at The Hague, and on 14 April 2002 the Permanent Court of Arbitration handed down a final and binding award granting the greater part of the disputed area to Eritrea; the boundary commission confirmed in 2005 that Badme belonged to Eritrea, but Ethiopia did not implement the ruling in full and the dispute dragged on. Militarily, Eritrea's armoured forces were described as having been gutted, and a system that depended on the Sawa conscription regime to sustain its manpower could not be carried on; the Eritrean army was squeezed at the border and in the interior at the same time. Ethiopia, though it kept its territory, was burdened with an enormous recovery and resettlement load, and its troops, equipment renewal and logistics all needed rebuilding. The war also pushed proxy conflict into the region: Eritrea supported the Ogaden National Liberation Front in Somalia, while Ethiopia backed opponents there and warmed relations with Sudan, and the risk to shipping and trade in East Africa and along the Red Sea rose in step.
result: 結果是埃塞俄比亞取得軍事上的勝負，代價卻極為沉重。一九九九年二月「夕照行動」攻入厄立特里亞境內約十公里，三月十六日再向佐羅納正面堡壘發動大規模衝擊，五月十二日多路合成攻勢撕開西線，五月十七日渡過馬雷布河並切斷巴倫圖至門德費拉公路，五月二十三日占領首都阿斯馬拉以南扎蘭貝薩一帶的要點，厄立特里亞軍隊整體後撤；五月二十五日埃塞俄比亞宣稱戰爭結束，六月十八日雙方達成停火協議，七月三十一日安理會設立臨時安全區，十二月十二日簽署《阿爾及爾協議》，戰事至此正式收束，自一九九八年五月六日起算共歷兩年又一個多月。從戰果看，德梅地區實際落入厄立特里亞控制，邊界最終由仲裁裁決確認，厄立特里亞雖然輸掉戰役卻守住了爭議地，埃塞俄比亞則以慘重代價換來戰術主導權；然而雙方軍力都元氣大傷、邊界爭端未解，這場戰爭留下的傷痕延續至今，成為二〇一八年阿斯馬拉領袖峰會才開始收拾的舊帳。
resultEn: The outcome was an Ethiopian military victory bought at appalling cost. Operation Sunset in February 1999 drove ten kilometres into Eritrean territory; on 16 March came the great frontal assault on the fortified town of Tsorona; the multi-axis combined-arms offensive of 12 May tore open the western front; on 17 May the army forded the Mareb and cut the Barentu–Mendefera road; and on 23 May it seized key positions around Zalambessa, south of the capital Asmara, forcing the Eritrean army into an overall withdrawal. Ethiopia declared the war over on 25 May, the two sides reached a ceasefire agreement on 18 June, the Security Council set up the Temporary Security Zone on 31 July, and the Algiers Agreement was signed on 12 December, formally closing the conflict, which had begun on 6 May 1998 and had run for a little over two years. In territorial terms Badme ended up under Eritrean control, and the border was finally confirmed by the arbitral award: Eritrea lost the battle but kept the disputed ground, and Ethiopia bought the tactical initiative at a price that wrecked both armies. Neither side recovered its strength, the border dispute was not solved, and the scars of this war run to the present, remaining an old debt that was only picked up again at the Asmara summit of 2018.
